test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Autumn season in India comes under which among the following month interval?
solution:
The correct answer is __**October to November**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Autumn in India:-**

 
 
• It is also known as Sharad Ritu.
 
• It is a beautiful and pleasant season.
 
• **It lasts from October to November, and is marked by cooler temperatures, clear skies, and vibrant foliage.**
 
• The monsoon rains have subsided, and the air is fresh and crisp.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Summer in India:-**

 
 
• It is hot and humid, with temperatures often reaching over 40 degrees Celsius (104 degrees Fahrenheit).
 
• **The driest months of the year are April and May.**
 
 
 
• **Monsoon Season:-**
 
 
• It brings heavy rainfall to most parts of India.
 
• **It lasts from June to September.**
 
• The rains provide much-needed relief from the heat of summer, but they can also cause flooding and landslides.
 
 
 
• **Winter in India:-**
 
 
• It is mild, with temperatures ranging from 10 to 25 degrees Celsius (50 to 77 degrees Fahrenheit).
 
• **It lasts from December to February.**
 
• The northern parts of the country tend to be colder than the southern parts.
